user.title: Add a reminder
user.description: Name the chore and say how often it should be done.

tag.title: Choose its tag
tag.description: Scanning this tag (or its QR code) marks the reminder done.

menu_options.existing: Pick a tag Home Assistant already knows
menu_options.new_qr: Make a new QR code (no NFC tag needed)

scan.title: Scan the tag
scan.description: Scan the tag now with the Home Assistant app, then press Submit.

existing.title: Pick a tag
existing.description: Choose a tag from the list, or type a tag id.

error.name_exists: A reminder with this name already exists.
error.no_scan: No scan seen yet. Scan the tag with the Home Assistant app, then press Submit again.

data.notify_on_scan: Also send a message when something is marked done

data_description.tag_ids: Add the same tag to several reminders to make it a master tag. You can type a tag id.
data_description.times: 24-hour times separated by commas, for example 09:00, 14:00.
data_description.targets: Nothing is sent until at least one is chosen.

error.invalid_time: Use 24-hour times separated by commas, for example 09:00, 14:00.
error.tag_required: A reminder needs at least one tag.

no_notify_targets.title: NFC Reminders has nobody to notify
no_notify_targets.description: Overdue reminders are not being sent. Choose who gets them under Settings, Devices and services, NFC Reminders, Notifications, Configure.

mark_done.name: Mark done
mark_done.description: Marks one or more reminders done, the same as scanning their tag.

entity_id.name: Reminder
entity_id.description: Any entity of the reminder, for example its progress sensor.

when.name: When
when.description: When it was done. Leave empty for now.

create_qr_sheet.name: Create printable QR sheet
create_qr_sheet.description: Creates a link, valid for one hour, to a printable page with the QR code of every reminder.
